name: Gemini 335Le
summary: Gemini 335Le is an industrial stereo depth camera for AMRs, robotic arms and forklifts. It extends the Gemini 335L platform with Gigabit Ethernet and Power over Ethernet through an M12 connector, plus an M8 interface for power, synchronization and RS-485. Its IP67 enclosure, onboard depth processing and synchronized depth, infrared, RGB and IMU streams support mobile-robot perception.

description.en: Gemini 335Le is an industrial stereo depth camera for AMRs, robotic arms and forklifts. Its IP67 enclosure, onboard depth processing and synchronized depth, infrared, RGB and IMU streams support mobile-robot perception.
